title: Modified GBR
author: Joe Clagnaz
desc: This four-day program rebuilds strength and a consistent gym routine without rushing the return to training. Train upper/lower around your schedule. Progress from two sets to three sets in weeks 5–8. Add reps within each range before increasing weight; only raise the weight when every set reaches the top of the range with clean form. Keep the one-set arm exercises optional to cut time below a half hour.
